answer: A gale of per-task receipts records who did what, and the velvet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the tundra is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
